DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions supported by ActionTrail
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询操作审计支持的阿里云地域

DescribeTrails.description_en: Queries the list of created trails
DescribeTrails.description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表

GetTrailStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a trail

StartLogging.description_en: Starts a trail to begin event delivery of ActionTrail management events to OSS or Simple Log Service (SLS)
StartLogging.description_zh: 启用跟踪，开始将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS

StopLogging.description_en: Stops a trail and stops the event delivery of ActionTrail management events to OSS or SLS
StopLogging.description_zh: 停止跟踪，停止将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS

UpdateTrail.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an ActionTrail audit trail
UpdateTrail.description_zh: 调整操作审计跟踪的配置信息
